response.overview: Sasha is about to confess her feelings to her crush Max, but her plans collapse when her friend Alina spreads a rumor that turns everyone against her. Humiliated and betrayed, Sasha finds herself at odds with Danil, a guy she initially sees as her enemy. But as they are forced to spend time together, she begins to realize that first impressions can be deceiving — and that love can appear from the most unexpected place.
response.tagline: Love appears from the most unexpected place
response.title: Love again
